{{tt|KOC-CD-8905|Koch Records}} | tracks=13 | colorscheme=Kanto}} '''Pokémon the First Movie: Original Motion Picture Score''' is the English score to the first Pokémon movie, ''[[M01|Mewtwo Strikes Back]]''. It was released in the United States in 2000 by {{wp|Koch Records}}. The music was reused in the English dub of ''[[Mewtwo Returns]]''. Manny Corallo, Deniz Hughes, John Lissauer, [[John Loeffler]], Kenneth Lampl and Ralph Schuckett are credited as composers. The album is available on [[Spotify]]. It was re-released by [[Laced Records]] on August 15, 2025 and subsequently re-titled '''Pokémon: The First Movie'''. ==Tracklist== {| class="roundy" style="background:#{{colorschemelight|Kanto}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Kanto}}" !No. !Track Title !Duration |- style="background:#fff" |1 |The Birth of Mewtwo |4:03 |- style="background:#fff" |2 |Dragonite Takes Flight |2:08 |- style="background:#fff" |3 |Invitation to Danger |2:49 |- style="background:#fff" |4 |Surviving the Storm |5:20 |- style="background:#fff" |5 |Mewtwo's Island |1:48 |- style="background:#fff" |6 |Pokémon Vs. Clone |2:42 |- style="background:#fff" |7 |Tears of Life |5:33 |- style="background:#fff" |8 |This Is My World Now |3:09 |- style="background:#fff" |9 |Three on Three |4:39 |- style="background:#fff" |10 |Mew's Theme |0:37 |- style="background:#fff" |11 |Freeing Charizard |4:41 |- style="background:#fff" |12 |Adventure in Paradise |3:21 |- style="background:#fff" |13 |All Good Things Must End |1:57 |} ==Trivia== * On the original CD track listing, the song "All Good Things Must End" was misspelled "All Good Things Must Ends". This was corrected in the album's re-release on the American [[iTunes Store]]. * The track "Adventure in Paradise" contains music that was replaced in the movie by "[[Catch Me if You Can]]". * Most of the tracks used here are reused in ''[[Mewtwo Returns]]'', an animated series special that serves as a sequel to the first movie. * European releases of the CD listed the [[Pokémon Theme]] as a bonus track on the CD. {{so|Pokémon World}}, the theme for the show's [[S02|second season]], is featured rather than the correct theme music. ==Related articles== {{M01 navbox}} {{English CDs}} {{Project Music notice}} [[Category:English CDs]] [[Category:Movie soundtracks]] [[de:Pokémon: The First Movie (Single)]] [[zh:Pokémon The First Movie（原声集）]]
